bonuses.requirements: Hot Cryptocurrency Community Feeds| HTX CommunityPostHomeFeedHotRecommendFollowHotNewsArticlesCommunityHTX Research10/29 06:06Strategy earnings preview: a Fed pause, but can BTC buying continue?The Fed held rates at 3.75%–4.00%, with two members favoring a hike. Strong activity and elevated inflation leave policy dependent on incoming data. A pause does not signal an easing turn—or automatically make Strategy’s funding cheaper.That is the backdrop for earnings: issuance terms, investor demand and cash obligations still determine how much capital the company can raise and deploy.Strategy held 848,517 BTC as of Oct 25. During Oct 19–25, it made no ATM securities sales and neither bought nor sold BTC. Instead, it spent $204.9m of USD Cash repurchasing STRC preferred shares. It bought 267 BTC the prior week; STRC repurchases across both weeks totaled $398m.Buybacks may reduce future dividend costs, but consume cash now. The $4.83bn USD Reserve primarily supports dividends and interest; a separate $242.4m USD Cash balance serves multiple treasury uses. Neither is a blanket BTC buying commitment.Watch net capital raised, cash allocation and subsequent net BTC purchases. The estimated $20.91bn Q3 digital-asset gain is not full net income or cash received.More funding plus actual purchases would strengthen the case for new BTC demand. Reserves or buybacks taking priority may improve the capital structure without adding spot buying. Tighter funding could curb purchases. Authority to sell BTC is not evidence of a sale or forced liquidation.Oct 29, ET: US growth and consumer inflation data at 8:30 AM; Strategy results after the close, exact time unannounced; earnings webinar at 5:00 PM.HTX snapshot: 80,187 USDT, Oct 28 at 9:50 PM ET. Watch 80,000, 80,350–80,500 and 81,700–81,800 alongside hourly closes, spot volume and ETF flows. One buyer does not define the market.Sources: Fed, BEA, Strategy/SEC, HTX, Farside; see the full report. Levels may not hold. Not investment advice.M

Sources indicate that PIMCO sometimes begins to reduce its holdings just months after buying in. In addition to approximately $18 billion in Meta-related bonds due in 2025 (when the company became a cornerstone investor in an $18 billion debt financing deal, allowing Meta to build a large data center project in Louisiana without burdening its balance sheet), PIMCO's funds also invested $10 billion in Oracle-related transactions. Documents show that the company has currently reduced its holdings in both investments by about 50%. bonuses.requirements: KR1 Acquires 5,000 TAO and Launches Bittensor StakingHomeFeedNewsKR1 Acquires 5,000 TAO and Launches Bittensor StakingKR1 Acquires 5,000 TAO and Launches Bittensor Staking10/29 10:25On October 29, KR1 plc, an on-chain infrastructure company listed on the London Stock Exchange, announced the launch of its technical infrastructure operations on the decentralized artificial intelligence network Bittensor. The company stated that it has recently acquired 5,000 native network assets, TAO, and initiated staking as part of its technical infrastructure strategy. Based on the reward rate observed on October 28, the company estimates an annualized infrastructure income equivalent to approximately 6.6% of the current value of its deployed TAO holdings. The announcement noted that Bittensor is a layer blockchain supporting subnetworks that cover services such as AI inference, computing power, training, and prediction, with independent suppliers competing for network rewards based on performance. KR1 supports validators that assess the performance of service providers through staking, thereby earning a portion of the network rewards. There is no mandatory unbonding period for the withdrawal of TAO, allowing the company to retrieve its holdings immediately after unbonding. Rewards can be retained to expand the scale of productive assets or liquidated for subsequent investments and operational costs. The company will also disclose its TAO holdings and related infrastructure income in monthly unaudited updates. Keld van Schreven, Managing Director and Co-founder of KR1, stated that as AI enables more complex tasks to be performed by software, the demand for infrastructure related to intelligent supply is expected to grow significantly. bonuses.requirements: DBS Survey: 88% of Large Enterprises Have Used or Piloted Tokenized CurrencyHomeFeedNewsDBS Survey: 88% of Large Enterprises Have Used or Piloted Tokenized CurrencyDBS Survey: 88% of Large Enterprises Have Used or Piloted Tokenized Currency10/28 10:55On October 28, CoinDesk reported that DBS Bank commissioned EY to conduct a survey of 422 financial executives from large enterprises across 11 markets, each with annual revenues exceeding $500 million. The results showed that 88% of respondents have either used or piloted tokenized currency, with 24% having deployed it at scale, 43% having limited rollouts in certain markets, and 21% in pilot or proof-of-concept stages. Among the tools being used or planned for adoption, stablecoins accounted for 63%, tokenized deposits for 53%, and tokenized money market funds for 52%. Additionally, 71% of respondents indicated that real-time cross-border payments have improved or are expected to improve within two years. However, regulatory uncertainty, security risks, and challenges in system integration remain significant barriers, with approximately 64% of respondents hoping that banks will serve as a unified entry point into the tokenized currency ecosystem.BullishBearishLikeShareDisclaimer：The content above does not represent HTX's positions.，HTX does not provide any trading recommendations.。All Comments0LatestHotLatestHotTrending Topics

bonuses.requirements: Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent crude oil hits highest level since March | HTX InsightsHomeCrypto News行业资讯Bitcoin seeks support above $8...Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent crude oil hits highest level since MarchcointelegraphPublished on 2026-10-23Last updated on 2026-10-23AbstractBitcoin briefly fell below $81,000 after Friday’s Wall Street open as Brent crude oil hit seven-month highs amid Middle East tensions. BTC/USD dropped to $80,988 before recovering to around $81,600, with attention on reclaiming its 50-day simple moving average at $81,781. US stocks opened lower, with the S&P 500 down 0.6%, Nasdaq down 0.2%, and Dow down 1.4%, while the 10-year US bond yield stayed below 5%. Oil surged as concerns grew over potential US military strikes on Iran around the midterm elections. WTI crude passed $102 per barrel, its highest since Sept. 16, and Brent rose nearly 3% to $116, a level last seen in mid-March. Economist Robin Brooks noted a rare decoupling between oil prices and flows through the Persian Gulf, suggesting a “huge risk premium.” Material Indicators cofounder Keith Alan warned that if bulls fail to reclaim the 50-day SMA by the daily close, support could be tested in the $78,000–$80,000 range. Previous Cointelegraph reporting noted substantial BTC support between $80,000 and $81,500, where spot Bitcoin ETF investors’ aggregate cost basis sits.#50-Day SMA#Bitcoin#Bond Yields#Brent Crude#BTC Price#BTC Support#Crypto Trading#Market Risk#Middle East#Oil Prices#US StocksBitcoin (BTC) saw a fresh dip below $81,000 after Friday’s Wall Street open as Brent crude oil set new seven-month highs.Key points:Bitcoin briefly dropped below $81,000 at the start of Friday’s US trading session as stocks drifted lower and the US 10-year yield remained below 5%.
